title: Voltage on a charging RC circuit
statement: A 100 uF capacitor, initially uncharged, charges through a 10 kOhm resistor from an ideal 5.0 V source. Find the capacitor voltage V after t = 1.0 s.

derivation.title: RC charging curve
steps: Kirchhoff's voltage law: V0 = R C dV/dt + V.
Separating variables with V(0) = 0 gives V = V0 (1 - exp(-t/(R C))).

computation.title: Capacitor voltage after 1 s
computation.method: the closed form evaluated with NumPy
computation.code:
tau = (R * C).to('s')
result = {'V': V0 * (1 - np.exp(-(t / tau).to('dimensionless').magnitude))}

crossCheck.method: integrate dV/dt = (V0 - V)/(R C) numerically from V(0) = 0
crossCheck.code:
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
tau = (R * C).to('s').magnitude
v0 = V0.to('V').magnitude
end = t.to('s').magnitude
sol = solve_ivp(lambda s, v: [(v0 - v[0]) / tau], [0, end], [0.0], rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12)
result = {'V': Q_(sol.y[0][-1], 'V')}
